impact_assessment.why: Typing in the search box silently clears the album or date window and searches the whole library, which contradicts the visible scope
impact_assessment.benefits: Search becomes another narrowing axis instead of a reset; multi-word names match without a special syntax; no schema change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: search semantics change from whole-substring to all-words and scope is preserved; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: scope stays client-side
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the same LIKE escape, cap terms, test both scope preservation and multi-word matching, and make Show everything the explicit reset

[1/3] Plan: viewer records the tile that opened it, focuses Close, traps Tab/Shift+Tab inside visible controls, restores focus on close; Escape closes date/album menus outside; aria-live selection/trash counts, aria-keyshortcuts, Setup shortcut list; dogfood, README, ADR-023

impact_assessment.why: The viewer looks modal but keyboard focus stays on the page behind it, Tab can leave, and closing drops focus instead of returning to the photo
impact_assessment.benefits: Keyboard and screen-reader users get a predictable dialog; shortcuts become discoverable; no data or schema change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: focus behavior and a help panel; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one focus reference in memory
impact_assessment.mitigation: Capture focus only when the viewer first opens, filter hidden/disabled controls for the Tab trap, check the element is still connected before restoring, and test the cycle with Playwright

[1/4] Plan: native Android 8+ app (programmatic UI, MediaStore hash-verified sync over the existing API, Wi-Fi-only periodic JobService); pure-SDK build script using aapt2/d8/apksigner; signed debug APK in web/android; server page /android/ and APK download; tests, docs, ADR-024

impact_assessment.why: The project is iPhone-only; Android users have no client and no way to install one from the home server
impact_assessment.benefits: One APK install from the same home server; verified uploads reuse the existing API and journal; no server schema change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new Android endpoints/static page and an APK binary; dependency: Android SDK only at build time, no runtime libraries; concurrency: background job and manual sync can overlap; state: SharedPreferences last settings, server journal last sync
impact_assessment.mitigation: A single sync lock per process, all uploads hash-verified, periodic job limited to unmetered networks, cleartext allowed only for the home LAN, and the APK built and signature-checked before serving

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Native Android 8+ source: programmatic settings UI, MediaStore hash-first sync, /api/has before /api/upload, sync journal start/done, optional 6-hour unmetered JobService; pure-SDK build.py using aapt2/javac/d8/zipalign/apksigner

impact_assessment.benefits: One share action uploads selected photos with the same verified protocol; connection test catches a wrong address or key before a sync
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new exported ShareActivity and intent filters; dependency: none; concurrency: share upload and background job can overlap but each file is hash-checked; state: no new persistence
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the same hash-before-upload path, skip already-present files, keep a simple status screen, and rebuild/sign/verify the APK
